items.title: Being etale is etale local on the source
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that etaleness is etale local on the source (statement lines 7166-7170). The proof combines the general locality criterion with the characterisation of etale morphisms for Zariski locality on source and target, preservation under precomposition by an etale morphism, and the permanence clause (4) (proof lines 7172-7177). The level is H2: a short assembly in which each clause is identified with its input.
